name: The AnkiDote
author: mord58562
description:
Medical reference inside the Anki reviewer. Conditions, drugs, abbreviations, signs, preclinical, descriptive and psychiatric vocabulary already written on your cards is underlined and explained on hover, with written summaries, Australian units, spelling and guideline links, and a named chapter or guideline behind the entries that have one. Docks for StatPearls, DrugBank and UpToDate, plus a bring-your-own-account AI chat (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini / Copilot / Perplexity / DeepSeek / Grok / Duck.ai). The term library is a separate file from the add-on and updates itself, so corrected content arrives without an add-on update. Free and open source - the StatPearls, DrugBank and popup features work without any paid service; UpToDate features are optional and require your own UTD subscription or institutional access.

What's new in 2.7.0: The button at the bottom of a popup no longer scrolls out of sight on a long entry. Section headings are links only where there is a chapter to land in, instead of running a plain search and discarding the section. Section labels were rendering dimmed and are now at full strength, with the spacing between sections reworked; popups come out slightly shorter than before. A brand name now says which generic it is, and an alternate spelling says so too, instead of showing a heading that disagrees with your card. Five entries carried an alternate name containing another entry's name, which absorbed the neighbouring term and gave the wrong popup; they resolve separately now. StatPearls search results are stripped of the surrounding site furniture again after an address change. A DrugBank page no longer pops up the drug whose page you are already on, and DrugBank's promotional strip and second loading bar are hidden in the dock. The dock's loading bar always clears, including when a page's renderer dies. UpToDate chips open through the address configured in settings rather than the public site, so an institutional session is kept. Animated popup backgrounds stop when the system is set to reduce motion.
